::: {.qft-exam-body}
1.  Consider the scattering of the scalar field $\phi(\boldsymbol{r})=e^{i\boldsymbol{k}\cdot \boldsymbol{r}}$, where $\boldsymbol{k}=(0,0,k)$, within the Helmholtz equation.

2.  Find the Green's function of the Helmholtz equation.

3.  Consider a small aperture in an opaque screen shaped as (a) a square and (b) an equilateral triangle.

4.  Compute numerically the field behind the screen in the far zone.

:::
